title: Presidential Shingle Replacement in Gresham, OR
summary: In October 2026, French Roofing did a full tear-off on a home in Gresham, OR and installed new CertainTeed Presidential shingles, with a W-shaped metal valley where the two roof planes meet. Metal valleys carry water off faster and are easier to keep clear of debris.
scope: Full tear-off of the old roof
W-shaped metal valley where the two roof planes meet

photos.alt: New CertainTeed Presidential shingles going on upper slopes of a home in Gresham, OR
Tear-off underway with new shingle bundles staged at the ridge
Brown W-valley metal between new shingles and underlayment
